description: One Slovak fiscal year decoded from the structured statements filed with the RÚZ: balance sheet and profit and loss, 16 key items: net turnover (null = not published, never zero), operating income and costs, value added, staff costs, operating, financial, pre-tax and net result, income tax, total assets, non-current and current assets, equity, share capital, liabilities, plus prior-year comparatives as published in the same filing. Amounts in euros, never converted. Closing date comes from list_slovak_company_filings; scope defaults to the statutory filing. A unit whose legal form is not a served legal person's returns 404, not billed. Paid via x402 ($0.03 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

perimetre.description: Filing scope: statutory (default) or consolidated, never merged

type_depot.description: Filing type from the filings list (Riadna, Mimoriadna…), when two filings share the same closing date; defaults to the ordinary one

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_slovak_company_filing

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Slovak annual accounts (RUZ)
